analysis: The supplied changes are documentation only. CHANGELOG.md (units 12 and 13, head_text) is release-notes prose. It adds no code and weakens no control. Its statements about inline-video plaintext staying off disk, the runtime manifest union semantics and the hop-by-hop encryption model agree with the canonical threat model (T-003, T-050, T-034) and do not contradict it. docs/reference/configuration.md (units 0 and 1) adds a 'Runtime metallib snapshots' section documenting TMPDIR. When TMPDIR is absent, Foundation's temporary directory is used. When it is present, it must be an absolute path without NUL bytes to an existing writable directory. Invalid or inaccessible values fail snapshot creation with no fallback. The documented behaviour is fail-closed. TMPDIR is controlled by the provider operator, who is already adversarial under TB-003 and ADV-001. The snapshot is described as anonymous and is bound before the metallib is loaded, which relates to T-013 and T-034 integrity. This pass saw no code, so BinaryHasher.swift (makeRuntimeMetallibSnapshot) was not reviewed. If a later pass receives the corresponding source change, it should check that the snapshot really is unlinked or anonymous, that the hash is computed over the snapshot bytes actually loaded, and that failure does not fall back to the live path. These points are a coverage limit, not evidence of a problem. No new attack surface, regression or threat-model gap is evident from these docs-only units. Unit 8d39ffcfaa638a3c:0 carries only metadata (mode unchanged 100644) and is covered.
